attributes.action: Protect BBC Radio 4's public service programmes from further cuts
attributes.additional_details: BBC Radio 4 plays a vital role in British public life through independent journalism, consumer advocacy and informed debate. Cuts to programmes such as You and Yours and The World Tonight threaten the depth and quality of public service broadcasting. These programmes hold powerful institutions to account, champion consumers and inform citizens. We believe the Government must ensure sustainable BBC funding that protects distinctive, high-quality programming for future generations.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to review the impact of BBC funding arrangements on its ability to deliver distinctive public service broadcasting, and to work with the BBC to protect important programmes such as You and Yours, The World Tonight, Thinking Allowed and Free Thinking.

rejection.details: Decisions about which programmes to broadcast are a matter for the BBC.
